diagnosis: The assertion error after IdP signing certificate rotation strongly suggests the SSO metadata URL was not updated to reflect the new certificate. The customer’s plan tier confirms SSO is entitled, so this is a configuration issue.
reply: Thank you for reporting this. The assertion error you’re seeing is typically caused by a mismatch between the identity provider’s new signing certificate and the metadata URL configured in our system. To resolve this, please re-upload the updated metadata XML file from your IdP to our SSO settings. If you need guidance on how to do this, let me know. For now, I’ve referenced our [SSO metadata mismatch guide](https://support.example.com/kb-0006) for next steps.
